name: Linear
tagline: Look up issues and projects, file new ones, and keep them up to date.
summary: Look up, file and update issues, projects and cycles in the user's Linear workspace. Existing issues are changed only after the user approves.
can: Read the issues, projects and cycles your account can see
Change an issue's status, assignee or priority, only after you approve it

setup: In Linear, open Settings, then API, and under Webhooks choose New webhook. Only an admin of the workspace can.
Give it a name, and enter this address as its URL: {address}
Under Data change events tick Issues and Comments, and choose the team it is for, or all public teams.
Create it, open it, copy its signing secret, and give it to OpenKumi below.
